g.aria-label: Title text 'A winter week at each decision substation: observed power and four forecasts'

text.font-family: Matter XH, DM Sans, sans-serif

g.text: A winter week at each decision substation: observed power and four forecasts

g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Power as a percentage of the substation's effective capacity. Median forecast made one day ahead (left) and six days ahead (right) of each half-hour, against the observed power. Each substation's week is the 7-day block of the scored year in the winter months with the largest swing in observed power.'
